entries.06b2872a6da97f39: The medium- to long-term management plan “KENKO Vision 2035” began in fiscal 2024 and was revised in February 2026. Its vision is “Become the world’s number one in salad cuisine,” and its concept is “Global Food Solution Company.” Its basic strategy consists of a growth strategy and smartization as core functions, human capital investment, sustainability and social responsibility as the management foundation, plus an IT strategy. Under its business portfolio restructuring and growth strategy, it lists expanding sales of existing businesses through “Customer IN” and “Co-creation,” optimizing Salad Cafe and its cooking school (Kitchen Space 831), and raising the overseas revenue ratio from 10% to 30% by 2035.

entries.a99e0423b18ab758: The company explains that the long-life salad it developed first in the industry still holds the top market share, and that the product strength of its salads and prepared foods is a strength. It also has a structure that allows it to handle everything in-house, from raw material procurement through product development, production, quality control and sales, and has a track record of supplying mayonnaise for business-use salads since 1961.
entries.aab4db02089b941b: There are two reportable segments, the Seasonings and Processed Foods Business and the Prepared Food-Related Businesses, as well as Other (which includes the shop business), which is not included in the reportable segments. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥73,434 million for the Seasonings and Processed Foods Business, ¥18,180 million for the Prepared Food-Related Businesses and ¥740 million for Other, with the Seasonings and Processed Foods Business accounting for the majority.
